name: Margin Report Data 10
definition: Specifies the details of the margin data.

ReportingTimeStamp.name: Reporting Time Stamp
ReportingTimeStamp.definition: Date and time of submission of the report to the trade repository.

CounterpartyIdentification.name: Counterparty Identification
CounterpartyIdentification.definition: Data specific to counterparties and related fields.

EventDate.name: Event Date
EventDate.definition: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Choice between a Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) or a proprietary identifier as agreed with the counterparty.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Information related to collateral agreement existing between counterparties.

PostedMarginOrCollateral.name: Posted Margin Or Collateral
PostedMarginOrCollateral.definition: Information on posted collateral and margin.

ReceivedMarginOrCollateral.name: Received Margin Or Collateral
ReceivedMarginOrCollateral.definition: Information on received collateral and margin.

CounterpartyRatingTriggerIndicator.name: Counterparty Rating Trigger Indicator
CounterpartyRatingTriggerIndicator.definition: Indicates if a counterparty rating trigger is agreed by the counterparties for the collateral posted by the reporting counterparty.||Usage: If the element is not present, the CounterpartyRatingTrigger is False.

CounterpartyRatingThresholdIndicator.name: Counterparty Rating Threshold Indicator
CounterpartyRatingThresholdIndicator.definition: Indicates if a counterparty rating trigger includes a threshold that increases collateral requirements when the counterparty falls below the single-A rating or equivalent.||Usage: If the CounterpartyRatingTrigger indicator is false, this element is omitted.

ContractModification.name: Contract Modification
ContractModification.definition: Contract modification details expressed as an action type and a reporting level type.

TechnicalAttributes.name: Technical Attributes
TechnicalAttributes.definition: Specifies technical attributes of the message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
